Three-Warehouse Mutual Aid Agreement
Hearth City and two neighboring communities each manage their own warehouse, and work together to maintain clinics and roads along the route.

Initial agreement: Hearth City contributes 30 knowledge, and each neighboring community contributes 10 knowledge. Thereafter, every 600 seconds, send 12 medicine and 2 tools to each location; each location loads 12 wood in return onto the same truck for the trip back.

Before dispatching, Hearth City must retain 120 seconds' worth of food, medicine, and maintenance tools for its own needs. Once the local return wood is ready, the same truck returns along the original route under escort by the same transport workers.
